scientific_integrity: The exact finite inclusion-exclusion coefficient certificate is supplied with the proof; exhaustive state checks at widths one to four corroborate but are not an infinite-size proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Counts initially primitive three-periodic states only; does not count other periods, transients, or spatial-symmetry orbits. Founding 1978 article not fully text-inspected. Equivalent unindexed exact enumeration remains a historical-priority risk.
title: Twelve-term exact three-cycle census for refractory excitation on three-row rook graphs
